mapper.insert: INSERT INTO routing.routing_case (id, case_number, transport_request_id, transport_request_number, transport_request_version_no, quotation_id, route_policy_via, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, arrival_deadline, cargo_category, requested_at, quotation_expires_at, created_by, updated_by, confirmed_route_version_no, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{caseNumber}, #{transportRequestId}, #{transportRequestNumber}, #{transportRequestVersionNo}, #{quotationId}, #{routePolicyVia}, #{originUnlocode}, #{destinationUnlocode}, #{arrivalDeadline}, #{cargoCategory}, #{requestedAt}, #{quotationExpiresAt}, #{createdBy}, NULL, NULL, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO routing.route_version (routing_case_id, route_version_no, status, candidates_evaluated_at, candidates_found, selected_candidate_no, rationale, approved_by, approved_at, created_at) VALUES (#{routingCaseId}, #{routeVersionNo}, #{status}, #{candidatesEvaluatedAt}, #{candidatesFound}, #{selectedCandidateNo}, #{rationale}, #{approvedBy}, #{approvedAt}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO routing.route_candidate (routing_case_id, route_version_no, candidate_no, conforming, estimated_arrival_at, min_connection_slack_minutes, evaluated_at, oldest_info_acquired_at, info_insufficient) VALUES (#{routingCaseId}, #{routeVersionNo}, #{candidateNo}, #{conforming}, #{estimatedArrivalAt}, #{minConnectionSlackMinutes}, #{evaluatedAt}, #{oldestInfoAcquiredAt}, #{infoInsufficient})

INSERT INTO routing.candidate_leg (routing_case_id, route_version_no, candidate_no, leg_no, voyage_number, load_unlocode, discharge_unlocode, departure_at, arrival_at, cargo_cutoff_at, doc_cutoff_at, info_version, info_acquired_at, executed) VALUES (#{routingCaseId}, #{routeVersionNo}, #{candidateNo}, #{legNo}, #{voyageNumber}, #{loadUnlocode}, #{dischargeUnlocode}, #{departureAt}, #{arrivalAt}, NULL, NULL, #{infoVersion}, #{infoAcquiredAt}, #{executed})

INSERT INTO routing.exclusion_reason (routing_case_id, route_version_no, candidate_no, reason_no, reason_code, violated_at, threshold, info_version) VALUES (#{routingCaseId}, #{routeVersionNo}, #{candidateNo}, #{reasonNo}, #{reasonCode}, #{violatedAt}, #{threshold}, #{infoVersion})
mapper.update: UPDATE routing.route_version SET status = #{status}, candidates_evaluated_at = #{candidatesEvaluatedAt}, candidates_found = #{candidatesFound}, selected_candidate_no = #{selectedCandidateNo}, rationale = #{rationale}, approved_by = #{approvedBy}, approved_at = #{approvedAt} WHERE routing_case_id = #{routingCaseId} AND route_version_no = #{routeVersionNo} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'CANDIDATES_PRESENTED')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM routing.exclusion_reason WHERE routing_case_id = #{routingCaseId} AND route_version_no = #{routeVersionNo}
DELETE FROM routing.candidate_leg WHERE routing_case_id = #{routingCaseId} AND route_version_no = #{routeVersionNo}
DELETE FROM routing.route_candidate WHERE routing_case_id = #{routingCaseId} AND route_version_no = #{routeVersionNo}
mapper.select: SELECT id, case_number, transport_request_id, transport_request_number, transport_request_version_no, quotation_id, route_policy_via, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, arrival_deadline, cargo_category, requested_at, quotation_expires_at, created_by, version, created_at, updated_at FROM routing.routing_case WHERE case_number = #{caseNumber}

SELECT routing_case_id, route_version_no, status, candidates_evaluated_at, candidates_found, selected_candidate_no, rationale, approved_by, approved_at, created_at FROM routing.route_version WHERE routing_case_id = #{routingCaseId} ORDER BY route_version_no

SELECT routing_case_id, route_version_no, candidate_no, conforming, estimated_arrival_at, min_connection_slack_minutes, evaluated_at, oldest_info_acquired_at, info_insufficient FROM routing.route_candidate WHERE routing_case_id = #{routingCaseId} ORDER BY route_version_no, candidate_no

SELECT routing_case_id, route_version_no, candidate_no, leg_no, voyage_number, load_unlocode, discharge_unlocode, departure_at, arrival_at, info_version, info_acquired_at, executed FROM routing.candidate_leg WHERE routing_case_id = #{routingCaseId} ORDER BY route_version_no, candidate_no, leg_no

SELECT routing_case_id, route_version_no, candidate_no, reason_no, reason_code, violated_at, threshold, info_version FROM routing.exclusion_reason WHERE routing_case_id = #{routingCaseId} ORDER BY route_version_no, candidate_no, reason_no

SELECT c.case_number, c.transport_request_number, c.transport_request_version_no, c.origin_unlocode, c.destination_unlocode, c.arrival_deadline, c.requested_at, v.status, c.quotation_expires_at FROM routing.routing_case c JOIN routing.route_version v ON v.routing_case_id = c.id AND v.route_version_no = (SELECT MAX(m.route_version_no) FROM routing.route_version m WHERE m.routing_case_id = c.id) ORDER BY c.quotation_expires_at ASC NULLS LAST, c.requested_at ASC, c.case_number ASC
